description: This file defines the DispatcherActor class, an Akka actor responsible for dispatching signals within a distributed system. It handles message mapping, creates dispatch flows, manages actor initialization, and contains logic for multiplexing and message routing based on message types. The class interacts with other actors such as ThingsAggregatorActor and uses various utility classes for flow control and messaging.

classes.name: DispatcherActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for dispatching signals, managing message flow, and routing commands to appropriate actors within a distributed system. It supports configurations with or without pre-enforcement and handles multiplexing based on message types.

classes.name: ImmutableDispatch
classes.description: An immutable inner class representing a dispatched message along with its sender and associated aggregator actor, used internally for message handling within DispatcherActor.

methods.name: mapMessage
methods.description: Maps incoming WithDittoHeaders messages to ImmutableDispatch objects for internal processing.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates a sink that logs and handles unprocessed dispatch messages.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Retrieves buffer size from enforcement configuration.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props for DispatcherActor simply with pubSubMediator and enforcerActor.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props for DispatcherActor with pubSubMediator, enforcerActor, and a preEnforcer graph.

methods.name: createDispatchFlow
methods.description: Constructs the core flow graph for dispatching messages, multiplexing by message types, and routing to search or aggregator actors.

methods.name: multiplexBy
methods.description: Creates a graph to multiplex messages based on provided classes.

methods.name: searchActorSink
methods.description: Creates a sink to send messages to the search actor, with pre-enforcement applied.

methods.name: thingsAggregatorSink
methods.description: Creates a sink to send messages to the things aggregator actor, with pre-enforcement applied.

methods.name: preEnforce
methods.description: Applies pre-enforcement logic asynchronously before forwarding dispatches.

methods.name: initActor
methods.description: Performs initial sanity check and registers self with pubSubMediator.

methods.name: sanityCheck
methods.description: Verifies that the actor's path matches the expected path from the constants.

methods.name: putSelfToPubSubMediator
methods.description: Registers the actor with the pubSubMediator for distributed messaging.
